title: Jerry Wu
text:
I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University. I study comparative politics, with a focus on Chinese politics.
Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a B.A. in government from William and Mary in 2023, and a M.A. in politics from New York University.

title: Research
text: My research examines how citizens form and change their political opinions. A complete list is on my CV.
